def duration_in_seconds(duration)
  unless duration.is_a?(String) && /\A(?:[0-9]+[hms])+\z/.match?(duration)
    raise ArgumentError, 'expected a duration such as 1h30m or 45s'
  end

  seconds_per_unit = { 'h' => 3600, 'm' => 60, 's' => 1 }
  duration.scan(/([0-9]+)([hms])/).sum do |amount, unit|
    amount.to_i * seconds_per_unit.fetch(unit)
  end
end
